reasons: Cited § 24.1–24.4 matches the preferred position: unconditional Customer affiliate/successor assignment right with notice, Vendor assignment (including via change of control) gated on our reasonable consent with a competitor bar, and express denial of any Vendor termination/reprice right on our change of control.
No redline or comment was proposed, which is correct for a compliant classification; the rendered text is byte-identical to the original paragraphs.

Deterministic check confirms the successor/affiliate carve-out is present; rationale accurately notes § 24.3 is only a residual mutual gate and that § 9.2 contains no conflicting change-of-control trigger.
